title: Warden adversarial review findings
description: Typed output of a Codex (or Claude) adversarial review round against the Warden wallet program. Validated by an INDEPENDENT validator (packages/core/test/security-ledger.test.ts, scripts/review.sh) and never trusted merely because --output-schema was passed: that flag constrains the model's final response, not every JSONL event on the way there. truth_status and evidence_type are orthogonal axes and must never be collapsed.

reviewer_model.description: Model that produced this round, e.g. 'gpt-5.6-sol@max'. Recorded for the L8 A/B, never used to weight a finding.

base_sha.description: The SHA the diff was taken against. Findings are scoped to base_sha..HEAD.

seeded_invariants.description: Every invariant ID the prompt seeded. Silence on a seeded invariant is a FAIL, not a pass, which is why the list is echoed back and why invariant_verdicts must cover it.

sibling_files_read.description: The named cross-cutting files the round was required to read (transcript.rs, state/session.rs, errors.rs, buckets.rs). The 1A pilot's one false positive came from reviewer scope, not model identity.

invariant_verdicts.description: Exactly one verdict per seeded invariant. 'not_reviewed' is a FAIL condition for the round, not a neutral value.

verdict.description: upheld = the reviewer looked and found no violation in this diff. It does NOT promote the ledger row; only an evidence artefact or a human adjudication does.

findings.description: Every finding, INCLUDING disputed and scoped-out ones. A round that reports only adopted findings produces a survivorship artifact, not a false-positive rate.

sha.description: A git object SHA, short or full, lowercase hex.

id.description: Stable finding id, allocated per repo (not per round) so a finding can be re-raised, disputed and closed under one identity.

severity.description: Impact if the claim is true. Independent of truth_status: a POTENTIAL finding can be critical.

truth_status.description: The claim's standing. Everything a model raises enters as POTENTIAL. CONFIRMED requires an evidence artefact of an allowed type OR a recorded human security adjudication; model agreement is a confidence signal and never promotes on its own.

evidence_type.description: HOW it is known — orthogonal to truth_status. 'none' is only legal while truth_status is POTENTIAL: a CONFIRMED or REFUTED finding must name its evidence. Never collapse this with truth_status: 'no red test => inconclusive' would discard static traces, supply-chain and dependency-provenance findings, key-management and release-credential failures, upgrade-authority misconfiguration, economic/MEV and liveness attacks, and formal counterexamples.

file.description: Repo-relative path. Use the path the claim is ABOUT, not the path the diff touched, when they differ.

invariant_ids.description: Ledger rows this finding contradicts or extends. May be empty for a finding that names a gap the ledger has no row for — that itself is an action item: add the row.

reproducer.description: Required only where one is FEASIBLE. When present it must FAIL on base_sha and PASS on fixed_sha — 'fails on HEAD' is the wrong predicate once a fix has landed. Where infeasible, set null AND set reproducer_infeasible_reason; the finding then routes to human security adjudication and is NEVER auto-downgraded.

verified.description: True only once both directions have been RUN and observed: red at base_sha, green at fixed_sha.

reproducer_infeasible_reason.description: Why no reproducer exists — e.g. supply-chain provenance, release-credential handling, upgrade-authority configuration, economic/MEV, liveness. Required whenever reproducer is null.

rationale.description: The argument, not a restatement of the title. For a REFUTED finding this is the adjudication rationale.
